text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian parliament on Thursday votes confidence in the new cabinet of Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski.

- There are a lot of German marks in private exchange offices but no one is buying them. The paper's sources from the Macedonian National Bank say the reason is poverty of the citizens and late salaries and pensions.
- President of the Macedonian Chamber of Commerce Dusan Petreski criticised the Macedonian government's economic policy: "Measures in the macro-economic policy are without an economic foundation."
- Svetozar Janevski is the new chairman of the Chamber of Commerce assembly. Janveski is the general manager and owner of the most successful corporation in Macedonia the brewery Skopska Pivara.

- Leader of the ethnic Albanian nationalist PDPA party Arben Dzaferi proposed that Macedonians and ethnic Albanians should have their separate flags that identifies their two peoples. The Macedonian national flag should be the identification of the state as a whole. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
